@@ base-fe-coalesce (ok)
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = COALESCE(fe, $1) WHERE repo_id = $2
@@ selfjoin-ar reads another row's stored
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = r2.ar FROM aveloxis_data.repos r2 WHERE r2.repo_id = r.repo_id
@@ selfjoin-ar same row via alias
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = r2.ar || 'x' FROM aveloxis_data.repos r2 WHERE r2.repo_id = repos.repo_id
@@ cte-over-target ar
WITH old AS (SELECT repo_id, ar FROM aveloxis_data.repos) UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = old.ar FROM old WHERE old.repo_id = r.repo_id
@@ subselect-in-from ar
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = s.x FROM (SELECT repo_id, ar AS x FROM aveloxis_data.repos) s WHERE s.repo_id = r.repo_id
@@ view-in-subselect ar
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = (SELECT v.ar FROM aveloxis_data.v_repos v WHERE v.repo_id = r.repo_id)
@@ view-in-from ar
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = v.ar FROM aveloxis_data.v_repos v WHERE v.repo_id = r.repo_id
@@ fe guarded bare from selfjoin
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = COALESCE(r.fe, r2.fe) FROM aveloxis_data.repos r2 WHERE r2.repo_id = r.repo_id + 1
@@ pnn incoming is $ but stored is from-other
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET pnn = COALESCE($1, r2.pnn) FROM aveloxis_data.repos r2 WHERE r2.repo_id = r.repo_id + 1
@@ g with selfjoin
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET g = GREATEST(COALESCE($1, r.g), COALESCE(r.g, $1)) FROM aveloxis_data.repos r2 WHERE r2.repo_id = r.repo_id
@@ conflict alias x
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos AS x (repo_id, fe) VALUES ($1,$2) ON CONFLICT (repo_id) DO UPDATE SET fe = COALESCE(x.fe, EXCLUDED.fe)
@@ conflict alias excluded-other-col
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos AS x (repo_id, fe) VALUES ($1,$2) ON CONFLICT (repo_id) DO UPDATE SET pnn = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.pnn, x.pnn), pn = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.pn,''), repos.pn)
@@ conflict bare stored
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id, fe) VALUES ($1,$2) ON CONFLICT (repo_id) DO UPDATE SET fe = COALESCE(fe, EXCLUDED.fe)
@@ conflict guard in DO UPDATE WHERE
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id, fe) VALUES ($1,$2) ON CONFLICT (repo_id) DO UPDATE SET fe = EXCLUDED.fe WHERE repos.fe IS NULL
@@ conflict guard in index predicate only
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id, fe) VALUES ($1,$2) ON CONFLICT (repo_id) WHERE fe IS NULL DO UPDATE SET fe = EXCLUDED.fe
@@ conflict excluded in subselect
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id, ar) VALUES ($1,$2) ON CONFLICT (repo_id) DO UPDATE SET ar = (SELECT EXCLUDED.ar)
@@ conflict subselect aliased excluded over target
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id, ar) VALUES ($1,$2) ON CONFLICT (repo_id) DO UPDATE SET ar = (SELECT excluded.ar FROM aveloxis_data.other excluded LIMIT 1)
@@ ar via function of stored other-col whole row
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = (repos).ar
@@ ar via quoted name
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = "ar" || 'x'
@@ ar via quoted uppercase (a different column)
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = "AR"
@@ fe guard with OR true
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1 WHERE fe IS NULL OR TRUE
@@ fe guard IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULL
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1 WHERE fe IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULL
@@ fe guard = '' only
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1 WHERE fe = ''
@@ fe guard on outer stmt of CTE
WITH u AS (UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1 WHERE repo_id = $2 RETURNING repo_id) SELECT 1 FROM u, aveloxis_data.repos r WHERE r.fe IS NULL
@@ fe default
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = DEFAULT
@@ io default
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET io = DEFAULT
@@ ar default
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = DEFAULT
@@ pnn default
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET pnn = DEFAULT
@@ fe coalesce(fe, default)?
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = COALESCE(fe, NULL)
@@ fe NULLIF trim
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(fe), ''), $1)
@@ fe NULLIF cast
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = COALESCE(NULLIF(fe::text, ''), $1)
@@ fe NULLIF ''::text
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = COALESCE(NULLIF(fe, ''::text), $1)
@@ fe three args
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = COALESCE(fe, $1, $2)
@@ fe case
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = CASE WHEN fe IS NULL THEN $1 ELSE fe END
@@ merge update
MERGE INTO aveloxis_data.repos t USING aveloxis_data.src s ON t.repo_id = s.repo_id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET fe = COALESCE(t.fe, s.fe), ar = s.ar
@@ merge update bare src with target-name alias
MERGE INTO aveloxis_data.repos USING aveloxis_data.src repos ON true WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET ar = repos.ar
@@ merge guard in WHEN MATCHED AND
MERGE INTO aveloxis_data.repos t USING aveloxis_data.src s ON t.repo_id = s.repo_id WHEN MATCHED AND t.fe IS NULL THEN UPDATE SET fe = $1
@@ merge guard in ON
MERGE INTO aveloxis_data.repos t USING aveloxis_data.src s ON t.repo_id = s.repo_id AND t.fe IS NULL WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET fe = $1
@@ merge insert io
MERGE INTO aveloxis_data.repos t USING aveloxis_data.src s ON t.repo_id = s.repo_id WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (repo_id, io) VALUES (s.repo_id, s.io)
@@ delete
DELETE FROM aveloxis_data.repos WHERE repo_id = $1
@@ insert-select same table
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id, io, fe) SELECT repo_id+1, io, fe FROM aveloxis_data.repos
@@ insert overriding
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id, io) OVERRIDING SYSTEM VALUE VALUES ($1, $2)
